user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Mech Repair Bay. An industrial repair bay with a kneeling battle mech: scaffolding platforms around its shoulders, sparks falling from a welding arm, hanging chain hoists, tool carts and diagnostic screens, hydraulic lines, an overhead gantry crane, hazard stripes, steam venting from the mech's joints, and warm sodium work lights cutting through the gloom. Style: gritty mecha. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
